name: CUMYL-PINACA
summary: CUMYL-PINACA (also known as SGT-24) is an indazole-3-carboxamide based synthetic cannabinoid.41nM for human CB2 receptors. In its pure form, it is described as a sticky oil which can cause poisoning through transdermal exposure. It has been detected as an extract of organic material by CanTEST in June 2026.

pharmacology.text: CUMYL-PINACA acts as a potent agonist for the cannabinoid receptors, with approximately 3x selectivity for CB1, having an EC50 of 0.15nM for human CB1 receptors and 0.41nM for human CB2 receptors.
